Facade 2 is an unofficial experimental fan project.

Original Fa?ade: (c) 2005-2006 Procedural Arts.
Design, writing, animation and engineering: Michael Mateas and Andrew Stern.
Original principal voices: Chloe Johnston and Andy Bayiates.
Generated character speech is synthesized locally from existing game references.
No endorsement or new performances by the original actors are claimed.
Original game material and Microsoft Comic Sans outlines retain their owners' rights.

Dialogue: Qwen3.5-4B / Qwen3.5-9B and MLC WebLLM 0.2.86 (Apache-2.0).
Voices: Chatterbox and Chatterbox Turbo ONNX (MIT), Resemble AI.
Chatterbox license source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/resemble-ai/chatterbox/5de7a54aa4e5e2baadb0182dde554908b48b85c2/LICENSE
Recognition: Whisper tiny.en (MIT), ONNX Community conversion.
Browser runtimes: Transformers.js (Apache-2.0) and ONNX Runtime (MIT).
Exact model/runtime revisions and SHA-256 hashes are in the release manifests.
The Turbo decoder repack shares byte-identical initializers without quantization changes.
